claims.reason: `hn` is the theorem's own binder, and no other binder and nothing in the conclusion mentions it, so the statement still elaborates without it. It follows from `hα`. If `n = 0`, then `pow_zero` turns `hα` into `1 = ((q : ℕ) : AlgebraicClosure ℚ)`. Mathlib has the instance `instance [CharZero k] : CharZero (AlgebraicClosure k)` (Mathlib/FieldTheory/IsAlgClosed/AlgebraicClosure.lean:205), and ℚ has characteristic zero. So `Nat.cast_eq_one` / `exact_mod_cast` gives `(q : ℕ) = 1`. That contradicts `q.2 : (q : ℕ).Prime` through `Nat.Prime.ne_one`, since `Nat.Primes` is the subtype `{p // p.Prime}`. The proof can therefore derive `hn` at the start and then go on unchanged; it uses `hn` only through `hn.ne'` and `Nat.mul_pos hn _`. The theorem stays true and provable without the binder.
